architecture: shared 128->256 clipped linear transform per view; product splits 256 into halves and computes 128 rounded products per view; value 256->1 and policy 256->32->65; control uses original 512-dimensional dual-view heads
confounds: Product changes interaction and compresses head input 512 to256; not a pure multiplication-only ablation. Same-protocol fully trained linear control is included.
training: Both from scratch, all layers jointly trained, identical data/order/D4 random sequence; QAT of weights and biases throughout, STE for product rounding; no distillation or custom game features
quantization: transform weights/bias scale256, heads weight256 bias65536; product integer (a*b+128)//256, a,b in0..256
checkpointSelection: validation MSE+CE minimum and value MSE minimum; test after both models freeze

dataset.filters: complete games; placements 8..56, stride 3; 8-symmetry/color-relative position dedup; test/validation ownership before train
dataset.split: native converter canonical first 8 moves; no move-wise split
dataset.target: recorded final black disc difference / 64, from side-to-move view

labels.label: first same-split, same-board/turn and same-outcome recorded next move
labels.split: unchanged frozen opening-group splits and symmetry-deduplicated positions
labels.passPolicy: existing cache excludes pass targets; forced pass is deterministic at inference

nativeTests.productBatch: scalar parity at batch1/8/32/128; int64 fallback; all existing NNUE/CNN tests

nativeSpeed.backend: identical virtual-visit scheduler and Accelerate matrix backend; cold search
nativeSpeed.limits: Four positions, two timed positions; speed diagnosis, no strength claim
